messages:
kai: CI red on master: https://ci.internal/reports/4823 — failing runtime.tests.test_batch_coordinator::test_parallel_batch_ordering. Failed 3/60. Anyone seen this recently?
ci-bot: CI: build #4823 failed (intermittent). Artifacts uploaded: https://ci.internal/artifacts/4823/ — rerun suggested.
sophia: I can take a look. Stack shows an ordering assert between batch start events, looks like a race where two batches flip order.
ravi: That rings a bell — we had a nondeterministic map iteration in batch_dispatcher before. Quick try: set PYTHONHASHSEED=0 or disable per-test shuffle envs.
kai: Trying local repro now: `PYTHONHASHSEED=7 pytest -k test_parallel_batch_ordering -q` — will run in a loop.
dave: FYI I added a tiny log dump in a local branch that prints event timestamps and thread ids when the assert trips.
sophia: Another flag: `SERVE_BATCH_DETERMINISTIC=1` exists in e2e suite. Not exported for unit tests, but flipping it could force deterministic ordering for a repro.
mentor-bot: Tip: when requesting a bisect include the failing image tag + the exact seed that reproduced the failure. That speeds up the bisect run.
ravi: If you want to brute-force seeds: `for s in {1..200}; do PYTHONHASHSEED=$s pytest -q runtime/tests/test_batch_coordinator.py::test_parallel_batch_ordering || echo "FAILED seed $s"; done`
kai: quick update: after 120 iterations with PYTHONHASHSEED=7 I got one failure. Logs: https://gist.internal/kairepro/4998 — shows two batches start in reversed order with a tiny prefetch callback running between enqueues.
sophia: Hmm, prefetch thread racing with dispatcher. For a short-term mitigation I can add a test-only yield/sync point in dispatcher so unit tests get deterministic ordering. Then we can bisect and fix the root cause in the scheduler.
ravi: Sounds good. If we add sentinel, please add a clear comment and a follow-up issue to remove it after scheduler fix. Also add the seed to the test so CI can rerun deterministic repro when it fails.
dave: I'll open a small PR that adds a debug dump helper and the sentinel flag behind `TEST_FORCE_DETERMINISTIC_BATCH=1`.
kai: Please tag me and I'll trigger repeated CI runs and a bisect if it still flakes.
sophia: PR incoming in a few mins. Patch will: 1) enable sentinel when env var present, 2) emit a concise timestamped log on failure, 3) add a flake note in the test docstring.
kai: :thumbsup: thanks. If CI still flakey after PR, I can run a git-bisect across the rolling commits from the last green to locate the regression.
ci-bot: Rerun queued for PR #4824. Requested by kai.
mentor-bot: Reminder: attach the failing job id and seed in the PR description for the on-call bisect run.
